## Motivation

Serve [FastVideo/FastVideo-FastH3-Omni-8-Step-V1](https://huggingface.co/FastVideo/FastVideo-FastH3-Omni-8-Step-V1), the Ref2VA Parallel Decoding Distillation (PDD) student of MiniMax-H3, the same way FastH3 V2 and VDN-H3 are served: a model overlay adapts the checkpoint offline, and the runtime reuses the native MiniMax-H3 pipeline, the existing PDD head loading, and VSA-H3.

The release ships only `transformer_ref/` (the FastH3 V2 Diffusers export with 32 interval output heads) and `fastvideo_inference.json`; the conditioner and VAEs are the base MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA ones, pinned by that contract.

## FastH3 vs. FastH3 Omni

| | FastH3 8-Step V2 | FastH3 Omni 8-Step V1 |
|---|---|---|
| Model ID | `FastVideo/FastVideo-FastH3-8-Step-V2` | `FastVideo/FastVideo-FastH3-Omni-8-Step-V1` |
| Task | t2va | ref2va (ordered image / video / audio references) |
| Distillation | DMD2, 8 trained rungs (999 → 125) | PDD: 32 intervals, 8 blocks of 4, one backbone forward per block |
| DiT forwards | 8 | 8 |
| Sigma shift (video / audio) | 10 / 3 | 12 / 3, grid scaled by `grid_max_t = 0.999` |
| Output head | standard | 32 interval heads, fused offline into 8 per-step heads |
| VSA-H3 tile | 64 tokens (4, 4, 4) | 128 tokens (4, 4, 8), run as two 64-token kernel blocks |
| VSA sparsity | 0.8 on the generated video | 0.9 on the generated video; each reference video keeps 10% of its tiles |
| References | – | clean (cond noise aug 1.0), target-only flow |
| Shipped components | transformer, VAEs, text encoder | transformer only; text encoder and VAEs come from `MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3@9bfb669` (Ref2VA) |
| Runtime model-specific code | config + sampling params | config + sampling params (DiT unchanged) |

## Modifications

FastH3 Omni is served through the existing MiniMax-H3 paths. Like FastH3 V2 and VDN-H3, the checkpoint is adapted offline by a model overlay, so the DiT has no Omni-specific code.

- **Overlay**: maps `transformer_ref` to `transformer`, fuses the 32 PDD heads into 8 (with the existing `fuse_minimax_h3_pdd_heads` math), and links the Ref2VA conditioner and VAEs at the pinned base revision.
- **PDD**: the model index can name fused heads (`_minimax_h3.pdd_fused_heads`), which are loaded through the existing `load_pdd_fused_heads`. `pdd_config.json` gains `sigma_max`, which scales the PDD grid.
- **VSA-H3**: adds ref2va support. Each reference video is tiled as its own region with per-region top-k (FastVideo `p2_multi_region`). Also supports 128-token logical tiles. The t2va/fl2va path is unchanged.
- **Config**: adds `FastH3OmniPipelineConfig` / `FastH3OmniSamplingParams` and the registry entry.


`sglang generate --model-path FastVideo/FastVideo-FastH3-Omni-8-Step-V1` with no overlay override downloads the overlay, materializes it on first launch (3 s on this host with the source weights cached) and generates; the materialized PDD heads, configs, index and re-written shard are byte-identical to the local overlay the results below were measured with.

## Accuracy Tests

2× H200, Ulysses 2, seed 0, 124 frames at 24 FPS with 32 kHz stereo audio.

- Ref2VA single-image (480p) and video-with-audio (480p) requests produce decodable MP4s with 24 FPS video and 32 kHz stereo audio streams; same-config reruns are bit-identical.
- The fused heads match a direct fp32 fusion of the release heads to 2.4e-7 (fp32 rounding); the VSA-H3 region path matches a standalone pure-PyTorch implementation of the same policy on the real 480p geometry to one bf16 ulp.
- This 8-step student is very sensitive to rounding-level differences: the same reference implementation run on 1 vs 2 GPUs differs at SSIM 0.74. Outputs are therefore compared by eye rather than per pixel; FastVideo (seed 0) gives a different but equally valid sample of the same subject and scene, consistent with framework-specific initial noise.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

**Setup.** 2× H200 on one host, BF16 student weights, the same five requests (prompt, references, seed 0, 8 steps), 124 frames at 24 FPS with 32 kHz stereo audio. Each case runs one full warmup request, then three measured requests; latency stops when the MP4 is saved.

| | SGLang (this PR) | FastVideo (`cdda1b75`, official BF16 multi-GPU config) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Parallelism | Ulysses 2, TP 1 | SP 2, FSDP DiT |
| Offload | DiT, text encoder, VAE to CPU (pinned) | text encoder, VAE to CPU (unpinned) |
| VSA | VSA-H3, Triton 64-token blocks | `FASTVIDEO_VSA_TRITON=1` (64-token halves) |
| Timer | HTTP submit → job completed (50 ms poll) | in-process `generate()` |
| Startup | 40.0 s to `/health` | 118.8 s generator load |

**Warm latency (median of 3, min–max):**

| References | Short edge | SGLang | FastVideo | Speedup |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Image | 480 | **26.85 s** (26.82–26.91) | 53.42 s (51.44–53.52) | 1.99× |
| Image + audio | 480 | **27.75 s** (27.73–28.25) | 52.93 s (52.83–53.66) | 1.91× |
| Video with audio | 480 | **23.22 s** (23.12–23.33) | 47.09 s (45.03–47.09) | 2.03× |
| Image | 768 | **46.61 s** (46.48–46.65) | 74.22 s (74.08–74.24) | 1.59× |
| Video with audio | 768 | **37.06 s** (37.01–37.17) | 65.98 s (65.83–66.08) | 1.78× |

<details><summary>Every request (warmup = first request of each case)</summary>

| References | Short edge | Run | SGLang | FastVideo |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Image | 480 | warmup | 107.01 s ¹ | 64.46 s |
| Image | 480 | 1 / 2 / 3 | 26.82 / 26.85 / 26.91 s | 53.42 / 53.52 / 51.44 s |
| Image + audio | 480 | warmup | 28.31 s | 55.66 s |
| Image + audio | 480 | 1 / 2 / 3 | 27.75 / 27.73 / 28.25 s | 52.83 / 53.66 / 52.93 s |
| Video with audio | 480 | warmup | 23.48 s | 52.86 s |
| Video with audio | 480 | 1 / 2 / 3 | 23.33 / 23.12 / 23.22 s | 47.09 / 47.09 / 45.03 s |
| Image | 768 | warmup | 46.98 s | 82.97 s |
| Image | 768 | 1 / 2 / 3 | 46.61 / 46.48 / 46.65 s | 74.08 / 74.22 / 74.24 s |
| Video with audio | 768 | warmup | 37.03 s | 70.41 s |
| Video with audio | 768 | 1 / 2 / 3 | 37.17 / 37.01 / 37.06 s | 65.83 / 65.98 / 66.08 s |

¹ First request after server start (`--warmup-mode off`): first-use component placement and kernel compilation. FastVideo peak memory is 47.7–48.9 GB per GPU.
</details>

**Stage breakdown, 480p image, warm** (SGLang stage timers; FastVideo with `FASTVIDEO_STAGE_LOGGING=1`, two warm runs):

| Stage | SGLang | FastVideo |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Text + reference conditioning | 0.66 s + 1.78 s | 15.77 / 11.37 s |
| Latent preparation | 0.01 s | 2.96 / 4.42 s |
| Denoising, 8 PDD steps | 21.85 s (2.73 s/step) | 27.82 / 29.97 s |
| Video + audio decode | 1.77 s | 4.95 + 0.18 s |
| Total | 26.67 s | 51.99 / 52.10 s |

Most of the gap is outside the DiT: per-request movement of the offloaded 63 GB text encoder and 9.8 GB video VAE (host-to-device on this host: 55.5 GB/s pinned vs 22.3 GB/s pageable), and the H3 VAE fast path. Denoising is about 25% faster with a full DiT replica per GPU and the pipelined Ulysses exchange versus FSDP weight gathers. These are deployment-recipe comparisons, not isolated kernel measurements.

**FastH3 V2 regression.** The VSA-H3 refactor keeps the 64-token single-region path that FastH3 V2 uses. On 2× H200 (Ulysses 2, VSA-H3 auto-selected), `FastVideo/FastVideo-FastH3-8-Step-V2` t2va (seed 0) produces byte-identical MP4s (same sha256) on this branch and on its base `844d2b5`, at 480p and at 768p.
## Generated samples


https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b79d2490-bcc0-4421-a9e6-7aab6af70e47


https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/41372065-a8a4-42ce-b79d-78f97514a8bc



## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+### FastH3 Omni: Ref2VA, 8-step PDD

+[FastVideo/FastVideo-FastH3-Omni-8-Step-V1](https://huggingface.co/FastVideo/FastVideo-FastH3-Omni-8-Step-V1)
+is a Parallel Decoding Distillation (PDD) student of the MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA

+sparsity on 128-token (4, 4, 8) tiles and each reference video keeping 0.1 of
+its tiles. Only `task: "ref2va"` is served, with up to 9 images, 3 videos and 3
+audio clips as ordered references (12 in total), at least one of them visual.
+
+Pass the repository directly to `--model-path`. Its registered model overlay
+maps `transformer_ref/` into the base-H3 layout, fuses the 32 interval output
+heads into 8 per-step heads (the math of `tools/fuse_minimax_h3_pdd_heads.py`)
+and links the text encoder and VAEs from the `MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3` Ref2VA
+partition pinned by the release. The served model is the native H3 pipeline:
+the release's `pdd_fused_heads` load through the same path as the PDD LoRA
+recipe above, and the PDD grid is the 8-step shifted grid scaled to the
+release's `sigma_max` of 0.999 (FastGen's `max_t`).
+
+```bash 2×H200
+sglang serve \
+  --model-path FastVideo/FastVideo-FastH3-Omni-8-Step-V1 \
+  --num-gpus 2 --ulysses-degree 2 \
+  --dit-cpu-offload true --text-encoder-cpu-offload true --vae-cpu-offload true \
+  --port 30010
+```
+
+```json Request
+{
+  "model": "FastVideo/FastVideo-FastH3-Omni-8-Step-V1",
+  "prompt": "<Picture 1> is the appearance reference for <Subject 1>. [reference generation] ...",
+  "task": "ref2va",
+  "conditions": [{"type": "image", "role": "reference", "uri": "/path/to/subject.png"}],
+  "target": {"short_edge": 480, "aspect_ratio": "16:9", "duration_seconds": 5.0},
+  "seed": 0
+}
+```

+Requests default to `num_inference_steps: 8` and clean references
+(`imgvid_cond_noise_aug_for_inference` and `audio_cond_noise_aug_for_inference`

+region and take a per-region top-k, while text, reference images and audio
+rows stay dense. `--attention-backend-config` keys `vsa_tile_size`,
+`vsa_ref_keep_rate` and `VSA_sparsity` override the trained values.

+offload; median of three requests after one full warmup, 124 frames at 24 FPS
+with audio, until the MP4 is saved):

+    assert meta.span_sparsities == (0.75, 0.9)
+    # Each kernel block holds at most 64 rows, the lower half first.
+    halves = meta.variable_block_sizes.view(-1, 2)
+    assert torch.all(halves[:, 0] == logical.clamp(max=64))
+
+
+def test_reference_regions_need_keep_rate_and_exempt() -> None:
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="vsa_ref_keep_rate"):
+        _build(0.9, torch.device("cpu"), ref_keep_rate=None)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="compete"):
+        _build(0.9, torch.device("cpu"), exempt=False)
+
+
+def test_ref2va_segments_follow_packed_layout() -> None:
+    blocks = [
+        {"kind": "image", "latent_h": 8, "latent_w": 12},
+        {
+            "kind": "video_audio",
+            "ref_audio_t": 6,
+            "latent_t": 3,
+            "latent_h": 8,
+            "latent_w": 12,
+        },
+        {"kind": "audio", "ref_audio_t": 5},
+    ]
+    latent = (4, 10, 16)
+    packed = minimax_h3_packed_sequence_ref2va_blocks(
+        text_len=33,
+        latent_t=latent[0],
+        latent_h=latent[1],
+        latent_w=latent[2],
+        audio_t=20,
+        ref_blocks=blocks,
+        include_video_pos=True,
+    )
+    segments = _ref2va_vsa_segments(packed, latent, (1, 2, 2))
+    assert segments == (33, 0, 24, 12, (3, 4, 6), 10, 40, (4, 5, 8))
+    # Region rows are exactly the layout's sparse-eligible video rows.
+    cursor, region_rows = 0, []
+    for segment in segments:
+        rows = math.prod(segment) if isinstance(segment, tuple) else segment
+        if isinstance(segment, tuple):
+            region_rows.append(torch.arange(cursor, cursor + rows))
+        cursor += rows
+    assert cursor == int(packed["cu_seqlens"][1])
+    assert torch.equal(torch.cat(region_rows), packed["video_pos"])
+
+
+def _oracle(meta, used, q, k, v, gate):
+    """Masked dense attention over logical tiles, plus the gated compression."""
+    split = meta.blocks_per_tile
+    tile = meta.tile_elems
+    logical = meta.variable_block_sizes.view(-1, split).sum(-1).float()
+    n = logical.numel()
+    valid = meta.pack_index >= 0
+    src = meta.pack_index.clamp(min=0).long()
+
+    def tiled(x):
+        t = x[src].float().permute(1, 0, 2)
+        return t * valid.to(t.dtype)[None, :, None]
+
+    qt, kt, vt, gt = tiled(q), tiled(k), tiled(v), tiled(gate)
+    pooled = [
+        t.view(HEADS, n, tile, HEAD_DIM).sum(2) / logical[None, :, None]
+        for t in (qt, kt, vt)
+    ]
+    scores = pooled[0] @ pooled[1].transpose(-1, -2) / math.sqrt(HEAD_DIM)
+    prefix = meta.num_prefix_tiles
+    mask = torch.zeros(HEADS, n, n, dtype=torch.bool, device=q.device)
+    for (start, end), sparsity in zip(meta.video_tile_spans, meta.span_sparsities):
+        keep = _compute_topk(sparsity, end - start)
+        picked = scores[..., start:end].topk(keep, dim=-1).indices + start
+        mask.scatter_(-1, picked, True)
+    mask[..., :prefix] = True
+    mask[:, :prefix, :] = True
+    row_mask = mask.repeat_interleave(tile, 1).repeat_interleave(tile, 2)
+    row_mask &= valid[None, None, :]
+    logits = qt @ kt.transpose(-1, -2) / math.sqrt(HEAD_DIM)
+    out = torch.softmax(logits.masked_fill(~row_mask, float("-inf")), -1) @ vt
+    compress = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1) @ pooled[2]
+    out = out + compress.repeat_interleave(tile, 1) * gt
+    return out[:, meta.unpack_index.long()].permute(1, 0, 2)
+
+
+def _impl():
+    return VideoSparseAttentionH3Impl(
+        num_heads=HEADS,
+        head_size=HEAD_DIM,
+        causal=False,
+        softmax_scale=HEAD_DIM**-0.5,
+        num_kv_heads=HEADS,
+        prefix="blocks.3.attn",
+    )
+
+
+def _qkvg(device, used, seed=5):
+    total = (used + 63) // 64 * 64
+    generator = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(seed)
+    q, k, v, gate = (
+        torch.randn((total, HEADS, HEAD_DIM), generator=generator).to(
+            device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16
+        )
+        for _ in range(4)
+    )
+    return total, q, k, v, gate * 0.1
+
+
+@requires_cuda
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("tile_size", [64, 128])
+def test_regions_match_masked_dense_oracle(tile_size: int) -> None:
+    device = torch.device("cuda")
+    meta = _build(0.5, device, tile_size=tile_size)
+    used = _used()
+    total, q, k, v, gate = _qkvg(device, used)
+    cu = torch.tensor([0, used, total], dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    out = _impl().forward_varlen(
+        q,
+        k,
+        v,
+        cu_seqlens=cu,
+        max_seqlen=used,
+        cu_seqlens_host=(0, used, total),
+        attn_metadata=meta,
+        gate_compress=gate,
+    )
+    reference = _oracle(meta, used, q, k, v, gate)
+    diff = (out[:used].float() - reference).abs().max().item()
+    assert diff < 2e-2, f"tile {tile_size}: regions vs oracle max diff {diff}"
+    assert torch.all(out[used:] == 0)
+
+    # The deferred (Ulysses) gate fold sees the same per-block compression.
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention.backends.video_sparse_attn_h3 import (
+        vsa_h3_fold_gate,
+    )
+
+    unfolded, out_compress = _impl().forward_varlen(
+        q,
+        k,
+        v,
+        cu_seqlens=cu,
+        max_seqlen=used,
+        cu_seqlens_host=(0, used, total),
+        attn_metadata=meta,
+        return_compress=True,
+    )
+    vsa_h3_fold_gate(unfolded, gate, out_compress, meta, 0)
+    assert torch.equal(unfolded, out)
